concerns.text: The plan assumes a curated dataset of only **20** molecules (see Section 1. Curated Dataset Creation) yet the Success Criteria (SC‑001) require a statistically significant improvement (p < 0.05) and the Assumptions state the dataset should contain **at least 500 samples** to train a neural network. Training a 3‑layer MPNN on such a tiny dataset is methodologically unsound: it will almost certainly overfit, the paired t‑test will have extremely low power, and any reported significance would be unreliable. The plan should either acquire a substantially larger dataset (≥ 500 molecules) or replace the neural network with a model appropriate for very small sample sizes (e.g., kernel ridge regression, Gaussian process) and adjust the statistical evaluation accordingly.
